philippines.title: Flag of the Philippines

colors.note: Represents the sun and the first eight provinces that rebelled

desc: - A white triangle at the hoist with a sun and three stars, flanked by a blue upper stripe and a red lower stripe
- Designed by General Emilio Aguinaldo in 1898; the flag is flown with red on top in wartime
trivia:
- The sun represents the 12 rays representing the 12 provinces that revolted against Spain
- The three stars represent the three regions of the Philippines
- The colours represent equality (white), courage (blue), and sacrifice (red)
